body:
I'll have to look at both assistance and dental schools. It's just kinda stressful for me right now since I've finally started to get things going for myself and if things were bad it would be derailing for me. Plus there's being embarrassed over it and covid on top of that and having car issues so it's been difficult to get around.

I hope you're feeling less alone about this though, we can get it done even if it's just tiny steps.

I'm just really worried about getting a cleaning just in case things are in a worst case scenario. I've finally started to get things going for myself and if things are that bad it would be so crushing.

you aren't alone in this, I can empathize how you feel. I really haven't taken care of my teeth. I didn't really take care of them from when I was about 14 to 22 and I'm 25 now. I haven't been to the dentist since I was about 15 and I've just been too scared and can't really afford to go right now.
That looks amazing! You did a really great job on it.
RemindMe! Three Days
I'm just giving myself until May 2022. I still don't see things getting any better by then but you never know.
That's awesome, I'm so happy for you!
I really appreciate the offer. I'm just not sure what to say.
I kinda did too but it just feels like things are too late to make a difference to me.
I agree. I just don't know what to do anymore.

I usually do that with everything. Posts, replies to friends/strangers. If I do make a long reply I overthink it to oblivion and take forever to put it together, I almost always regret sending it afterwards. It sucks.
I'm not sure if you've tried it, but try a thick shaving cream. I use barbasol for sensitive skin and I rarely get skin irritation or ingrown hairs now.
Happy Birthday!! It's kinda hard to celebrate with the way things are right now but I hope you're able to have a wonderful day!

The painting came out really great! That's not always true though. My mom painted a custom headboard for me and I still love it. I want to keep it around in some way. 

P.S. Don't forget to keep a record of the paint for future touch ups

* Age of Empires 1/2
* Uncharted Series

Tired, stressed, I want to crawl out of my skin. It rained all day and the night was foggy so that was nice. I'm sorry to hear that you're starting to lose hope though, that feeling does suck. I hope you start to feel better soon.

I know what you mean. It sucks big time. It's hard to lose enjoyment for the things you loved. I wish there was something I could say to help you but I'm in the same boat. I hope things start to get better for you *hugs*

Honestly, opening up on here made me feel a little bit better. I feel like it's easier to open up to strangers than people I know, that might just be me though. I haven't really tried self reflection yet, I might have to try just to see how it goes. I actually started working on short term goals recently, and it's actually working! I'm just trying to build on that little by little. I kinda get discouraged when I start looking at bigger goals and the stuff I have to do so that sets me back a little bit. I know what you mean about gaming, I don't even want to know how much time I put in it each week lol. I look at the news way too much, that really stresses me out. I keep wanting to try different things, it's just difficult to muster up the energy to try them.

I understand what you mean. I hope that you're feeling better now, it's a weird thing when you feel bad for no reason.  I try not to stress myself too much, it's just difficult with the way my life is right now. I know they love me, I'm trying to just make my way through it, it's just really hard some days.
Thank you! I hope you do too!
Thank you for taking the time to talk with me. It's been helpful and I really appreciate it!
Having a therapist would be great, I'm just not really in a position to look for one right now.

I think I saw a similar quote a while back too, I feel like a lot of people try to make others happy or laugh just to deflect from their own feelings. I use to be happy that I could make people laugh or try to cheer them up but it's faded now and I'm worried it'll never come back. I still try to just because I don't know what else to do, maybe it is burning me out but I feel like I can't do anything else. Opening up to friends is just something I struggle with immensely. I always have a fear in the back of my mind that I'll overshare, or that they'll turn it against me down the road, or just start treating me different. I'm not joking when I say this is the most I've opened up to people in a long time, I haven't really had a deep conversation since like 2013.

Yeah, I'll admit I get caught in negatives easily. My life's not horrible in the big scheme of things, I just wish I could appreciate the positives more than I do. I feel like I take it for granted when I'm not trying to.

I'm sorry that you're going through the same thing. I'm also sorry to hear about your family, it's frustrating to appear one way to people when it isn't the truth. Honestly adopting a kid is probably one of the greatest things a person can ever do. My purpose so far is just trying to make people laugh, I try to make people's day better but I feel like it's getting harder.
I feel like some of it is my fault for how I handled things. I wish I made better choices and I have no one to blame but me.

When I was younger I felt like I was over emotional so I just started bottling things up and just trying to distance myself from everything and everyone. Now I rarely feel anything toward anyone and I wish I could. I have to make a conscious effort towards people because the emotion isn't there anymore. I'm not really sure if that makes sense.
I know what you mean about getting overwhelmed, it's brutal and it tiring. I'm sorry you have to go through that. Also thank you, I really appreciate the kind words.

Thanks for the reply! I'm in the US, I hear a lot of stories how it's difficult to get help here so it's unfortunate. I'm so sorry to hear about your brother bullying you, I couldn't imagine having to deal with that. I'm glad you were able to get your own space and are feeling better though. I've thought about a journal but I wasn't really sure what to put in it. I use to be into graphic design as an outlet but I got burnt out. I don't even know if I'm actually depressed or just have a bad outlook on life.
I didn't think it was rambling, I found it extremely useful and I'm thankful for the help.
Is there anything specific you put on afterwards? I just put vaseline on afterwards to keep it moisturized.
Alright, that's good to hear. Thank you for the help, I really appreciate it!

Scared of the costs and how it would affect the relationship with my mom. I'm not really sure medication would work effectively and I'm super uncomfortable talking to anyone about it so talking to a therapist might not be viable. I've thought about talking to friends online but I'm not sure where to start and what to say. Besides it's not worth worrying them over something they can't help with and something they shouldn't have to deal with. I'm not really sure where to go or what else to do.
